title: ParameterIDs (complete v1.0 inventory), APVTS, PluginProcessor with sidechain and MIDI bus
description:
Implement the complete v1.0 ParameterIDs inventory, APVTS parameter layout ownership in PluginProcessor, and AudioProcessor bus configuration for main/sidechain/MIDI.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
a.2 is the sole owner of CMakeLists.txt, PluginProcessor.*, and ParameterIDs.h in this phase after a.1. If target_sources or includes must change for ParameterIDs (header-only) or StateManager stubs later, only touch CMakeLists.txt here when necessary to keep the processor target buildable; prefer header-only ParameterIDs with layout built inside PluginProcessor.cpp.

Before editing, inspect:
- /home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/shredboost/Source/PluginProcessor.h and .cpp (BusesProperties, APVTS construction, get/setStateInformation stubs, processBlock shape)
- /home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/shredboost/Source/Parameters/ParameterIDs.h and ParameterLayout.cpp (ID string style)
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md parameter sections for ranges/names if present
- CMakeLists.txt from a.1

Implement:
1. Source/ParameterIDs.h
   - Namespace or nested struct of constexpr string IDs / ParameterID helpers for the FULL v1.0 automatable inventory (stable string values, no renames later):
   - Per band 1..12: enabled, stage, type, frequency, gain, q, slope, route, dynamicMode, dynamicRange, threshold, ratio, attack, hold, release, knee, detectorSource, detectorFrequency, detectorQ, trackingSource, trackingHarmonic, lookahead.
   - Global: inputGain, outputGain, globalBypass, analyzerEnable, abState, profileIndex, tuningIndex.
   - Tight Cut: enabled, frequency, slope, resonance, punchRatio, punchGain, punchQ, placement, routing, listenRemoved.
   - Chug Stabilizer: enabled, frequency, bandwidth, maxReduction, threshold, attack, hold, release, preservePick, transientSens, dominanceSens.
   - Multiband: enabled, crossover1-3 freqs, and per-zone (4 zones) gain/threshold/ratio/attack/release/transientEmphasis/sustainEmphasis/placement/detectorSource/autoThreshold/mode.
   - Sidechain: source, lockInEnabled, lockInAmount, carveMaxGain, carveThreshold.
   - M/S: sideHighPass, monoGuardEnabled, monoGuardProtection.
   - Resonance suppressor: 6 slots × (enabled, frequency, q, maxDepth, attack, release, persistence, mode, placement, freeze).
   - Note follower: trackingSource, harmonic, centsOffset, confidenceThreshold, smoothing, holdTime, returnTime, minFreq, maxFreq, midiPriority.
   - Lookahead mode (off/0.5/1/2/5ms) and output trim if distinct from outputGain.
   - Use a consistent prefix scheme (e.g. bandN_frequency, tightCut_enabled, chug_*, mb_*, sc_*, ms_*, resN_*, note_*, lookaheadMode).

2. Source/PluginProcessor.h / .cpp
   - Class ShredEQAudioProcessor : juce::AudioProcessor.
   - Constructor BusesProperties: main stereo input, optional sidechain input bus ("Sidechain"), stereo output. Standalone must run without sidechain present.
   - isBusesLayoutSupported: allow mono→mono, stereo→stereo, and stereo main + mono or stereo sidechain when sidechain bus is enabled; reject mismatched main/output channel counts.
   - Create juce::AudioProcessorValueTreeState in ctor via createParameterLayout() that registers ALL ParameterIDs with sensible default ranges (log frequency 20–20k, gain dB, Q, enum choices for filter types/modes). Layout may live as a free function in PluginProcessor.cpp or a private static method—keep it in allowed files only.
   - processBlock stub: clear unused outputs, ScopedNoDenormals, ignore MIDI for now (accept MIDI buffer then empty handling), no heap alloc.
   - prepareToPlay/releaseResources stubs; hasEditor true; createEditor can return nullptr until a.3 or a minimal forward-declare if compile requires—prefer returning nullptr with hasEditor() true only if editor sources already compile empty classes; coordinate with listed sources: implement a minimal editor include if the target already compiles PluginEditor.cpp (editor body is a.3—provide a tiny non-crashing createEditor that constructs editor if PluginEditor exists from wave 3 dependency; since a.3 depends on a.2, for a.2 provide PluginEditor forward declaration and createEditor returning new ShredEQAudioProcessorEditor(*this) only if editor headers exist; otherwise temporary nullptr and hasEditor false is NOT allowed long-term—create thin PluginEditor.h/cpp placeholders in a.2 ONLY if required to compile, but prefer a.2 not owning editor: keep createEditor returning nullptr and hasEditor() return false until a.3, OR hasEditor true with nullptr is invalid—use hasEditor() false temporarily is DRYER but phase wants editor later. Decision: hasEditor() returns true; createEditor() returns nullptr is bad JUCE practice. a.2 should declare createEditor and implement a minimal include of PluginEditor.h with a stub editor class moved to a.3 ownership—a.2 writes only Processor files. So define createEditor in .cpp including PluginEditor.h; a.3 supplies PluginEditor. Until a.3 runs, build may fail if editor missing—acceptable sequential wave.
   - getStateInformation/setStateInformation stubs that serialize APVTS state to/from XML ValueTree with a schema_version property (int, start at 1). Full A/B and presets are a.3 StateManager—processor may call through a simple apvts.copyState()/replaceState() only.
   - acceptsMidi() true (MIDI note following); producesMidi false; isMidiEffect false.
   - Expose getAPVTS() reference.

3. CMakeLists.txt
   - Only if needed: ensure Source/PluginProcessor.cpp remains in target_sources; do not add unrelated sources. Do not reassign company/plugin codes.

Do NOT implement StateManager, PluginEditor UI, DSP bands, or README/.gitignore.
acceptance_criteria: Source/ParameterIDs.h exists and declares stable IDs covering all 12 bands, Tight Cut, Chug Stabilizer, multiband crossovers and 4 zones, sidechain, M/S, 6 resonance slots, note follower, lookahead, and globals listed in the phase goal
Source/PluginProcessor.h and Source/PluginProcessor.cpp define ShredEQAudioProcessor with APVTS constructed from a layout that references ParameterIDs
PluginProcessor configures main input, optional sidechain input, and output via BusesProperties
isBusesLayoutSupported accepts mono, stereo, and stereo+sidechain layouts and allows standalone without sidechain
acceptsMidi() returns true; NEEDS_MIDI_INPUT remains enabled in CMake if CMakeLists.txt is touched
getStateInformation/setStateInformation round-trip APVTS state and include schema_version
processBlock stub compiles conceptually with ScopedNoDenormals and no intentional heap allocation in the hot path
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: implement EQ DSP, dynamics, multiband processing, or analyzers
change PLUGIN_MANUFACTURER_CODE or COMPANY_NAME away from NSPC / nSpace Systems

allowed: header-only ParameterIDs with createParameterLayout in PluginProcessor.cpp
optional sidechain bus with safe standalone layout support
APVTS XML state stub with schema_version property
minimal CMakeLists.txt target_sources touch if required for build graph
forbidden: own PluginEditor or StateManager beyond what processor linkage requires
rename parameter ID strings after defining them
full preset A/B engine inside PluginProcessor
implicit new plugin formats or manufacturer branding
